title_zh: 中国驻菲律宾大使馆：在菲绑架团伙头目邱某某被遣返，多次策划实施针对中国公民的严重暴力案件
title_en: Chinese Embassy in Philippines: Kidnapping Gang Leader Qiu Repatriated for Targeting Chinese Citizens
summary_zh: 中国驻菲律宾大使馆表示，在菲绑架团伙头目邱某某已被遣返，其多次策划实施针对中国公民的严重暴力案件。
summary_en: The Chinese Embassy in the Philippines announced the repatriation of Qiu, a kidnapping gang leader, who had repeatedly planned serious violent cases against Chinese citizens.
